A1.label: After a Frostflake Arrow
A1.reason: She fires Frostflake Arrows one after another, so the CRIT Rate from the last one is on while the next ones hit.

A4.label: Inside the Burst's field
A4.reason: A bonus for the character on the field inside her Burst, which depends on whether she stays on the field after casting it.

C4.label: Constellation 4, enemies in the Burst
C4.reason: Builds up while enemies stay inside her Burst.
